title: Incremental tool event stream
source_note: Authored development fixture with an explicitly bounded protocol; not an external benchmark or production incident. Python standard-library semantics only.

defect_notes.incident: Decodes each transport chunk independently, rejecting valid split UTF-8; accepts trailing same-call data after terminal events.
defect_notes.normal: Reference implementation satisfying the documented lifecycle, data, failure and isolation contract.
defect_notes.local: Counts words by ASCII-space splitting, including empty pieces; all stream composition mechanisms are unchanged.

validation_scope: Custom LF/JSON protocol, not an implementation or conformance test of full SSE.
Single-threaded parser lifecycle; no transport, clock, network or scheduling test.
Every two-way byte split and single-byte delivery are tested for one representative Unicode stream; this is finite coverage.
Frame bound is checked by observed acceptance and buffered_bytes; peak process memory is not measured.
